description: Copy-paste starting point for a design-guidelines task scenario. It runs green as shipped: bash 40k/tests/run_scenarios.sh tests/scenarios/visual/_template.json. Copy it to tests/scenarios/visual/T##_<slug>.json, run the copy once unchanged, then replace: (1) id, covers and the screenshot labels (T00 -> your T##); (2) fixture and transition_to_phase (GameState.Phase: 6 COMMAND, 7 MOVEMENT, 8 SHOOTING, 9 CHARGE, 10 FIGHT) for the board your feature needs; (3) the dispatched action and the expect_* / execute_script checks, reading the property your feature exposes, UI first and GameState second; (4) regions ([x, y, w, h] on the harness's 1920x1080 frame) and their pct bounds, measured from a real run, never guessed. As shipped: player 1 begins a normal move with the Blade Champion, the right panel's SELECTED UNIT block re-renders (measured 11% of selected_unit_panel) and the game log does not (measured 0% of game_log). Rules: tests/scenarios/visual/_schema.md.
